config.label: Full Ethora API URL
config.description: Full Ethora API URL. Defaults to https://api.chat.ethora.com/v1 if neither ETHORA_API_URL nor ETHORA_BASE_URL is set.

config.label: Base host URL (e
config.description: Base host URL (e.g. https://api.chat.ethora.com). The server appends /v1 automatically. Use ETHORA_API_URL instead if you need a non-/v1 path.

config.label: App JWT used for the user-auth bootstrap flow (login/register)
config.description: App JWT used for the user-auth bootstrap flow (login/register). Usually starts with 'JWT '. Optional; can also be set at runtime via the ethora-configure tool.

config.label: B2B server token used for tenant-actor x-custom-token auth (JWT with type=server)
config.description: B2B server token used for tenant-actor x-custom-token auth (JWT with type=server). Required for B2B / app provisioning flows. Optional; can also be set at runtime.

config.label: Set to 'true' to expose destructive tools (app deletion, wallet transfers, bulk delete)
config.description: Set to 'true' to expose destructive tools (app deletion, wallet transfers, bulk delete). Disabled by default.
